method: Hand computation from this vector's input.json and conventions.json together with docs/CONVENTIONS.md and the METRIC_DEFINITIONS in src/types.ts. No metric-computing code was written, imported or run, and no expected.json was opened while this file was produced.
rounding: Half-up to four decimal places; terminating values left exact.

resolutions.whatWasAmbiguous: What metric (e)'s single scalar denotes, given that Art. 9(1)(e) names two figures and MetricValue carries one.
resolutions.secondPassOriginallyChose: The overall proportion of workers receiving a component — 100 here.
resolutions.firstPassChose: The difference between the two per-sex proportions, in percentage points — 0 here.
resolutions.nowReads: CONVENTIONS.md, componentMap: the scalar is the MALE proportion minus the FEMALE proportion, in percentage points, positive meaning men are the more likely to receive components.
resolutions.why: Every other metric position in this report is a female-versus-male comparison expressed against the male figure; a bare overall proportion would be the only figure in the report that is not one.

resolutions.whatWasAmbiguous: Which of the four quartile bands metric (f)'s single scalar reports, given that Art. 9(1)(f) names eight figures.
resolutions.secondPassOriginallyChose: The lowest band's female share — 66.6667 here, the band the single leftover worker enlarged.
resolutions.firstPassChose: The highest band's female share — 0 here.
resolutions.nowReads: CONVENTIONS.md, quartileTieRule: the female share of the HIGHEST (fourth) quartile pay band, as a percentage.
resolutions.why: Attributable to the same national guidance document this key already borrows its tie rule from. Both passes had already built IDENTICAL bands, including the 3/2/2/2 remainder split; only the band reported differed.

working.step0_payDefinition: Same component map as v02: BASE basic, BONUS complementary_variable, nothing excluded. This vector is v02 plus one extra woman, w09, at the bottom of the distribution.
working.step2_sexSplit: Five women (w01-w04, w09), four men (w05-w08). n = 9, all sex values mapped, excludedN 0.
working.step3_metricA: Female totals 2000+2400+3000+3400+1800 = 12600 over five women, mean 2520. Male totals unchanged from v02 at 12800 over four men, mean 3200. (3200-2520)/3200 = 680/3200 = 0.2125 -> 21.25. The added low-paid woman widens the gap from v02's 15.625, which is the intended contrast.
working.step5_metricC: The female headcount is now ODD, so lower_of_two does not apply on that side: five women ascending 1800, 2000, 2400, 3000, 3400 -> the single middle value is 2400. The male headcount is still even, so lower_of_two picks 2800 from the pair 2800, 3600. (2800-2400)/2800 = 0.1428571... -> 14.2857. Identical to v02 by coincidence — the added woman sits below both middles and does not move the female median.
working.step6_metricD: Female BONUS ascending 150, 200, 300, 400, 500 -> middle 300. Male BONUS middles 400 and 600 -> 400. (400-300)/400 = 0.25 -> 25.
working.step7_metricE: All nine BONUS figures are strictly positive: 5 of 5 women and 4 of 4 men. Under the settled rule the scalar is 100 - 100 = 0 percentage points. (Originally reported as the overall proportion, 100; see resolutions.)

step8_quartiles.sizes: n = 9 gives 9 = 4 x 2 + 1. quartileRemainder is to_lower, and the convention document states that leftovers go one per quarter starting from the lowest, so the one leftover enlarges Q1 only: sizes 3, 2, 2, 2.
step8_quartiles.tie: No two workers share a total pay level, so quartileTieRule is not exercised. The remainder rule fires alone, which is what isolates it in this vector.

composition.Q1: positions 1-3: w09 F, w01 F, w05 M -> 2 F and 1 M -> 66.6667 percent female
composition.Q2: positions 4-5: w02 F, w06 M -> 50 percent female
composition.Q3: positions 6-7: w03 F, w04 F -> 100 percent female
composition.Q4: positions 8-9: w07 M, w08 M -> 0 percent female

step8_quartiles.scalarChosen: 0, the female share of the HIGHEST quartile pay band, per the settled rule. (Originally the lowest band, 66.6667 — the band the remainder rule enlarged; see resolutions. The cost of the settled rule is visible here: the leftover worker this vector exists to test changes Q1 and leaves the reported scalar untouched.)

working.step9_metricG: One category, Ops, holding all nine workers, so the category gap equals metric (a) at 21.25.
working.step10_suppression: minGroupSize null: no suppression, no unreliability.
working.step11_art10: Ops at 21.25 clears the five-percentage-point trigger and carries a flag.

ambiguities.issue: Scope of metrics (a) and (c): total pay, or ordinary basic wage or salary alone.
readings: Total pay — Art. 3(1)(a) defines pay inclusively and METRIC_DEFINITIONS restricts only (b) and (d).
Basic only — the payBasis heading says Art. 9(1)(a)-(d) report basic and complementary components SEPARATELY.
ambiguities.why: The frozen type is the contract and it carries the restriction on (b) and (d) alone. Under the other reading metric (a) here runs over BASE only: female mean 2210, male mean 2700, giving 18.1481 rather than 21.25.

ambiguities.issue: Metric (e) is a two-sided proportion carried in a one-scalar MetricValue.
readings: The overall proportion receiving a component.
The percentage-point difference between the two proportions.
ambiguities.chosen: The overall proportion receiving a component
ambiguities.why: The difference reading collapses every vector to zero and destroys the contrast v09 is built to show.
ambiguities.supersededBy: resolutions[0] — the passes disagreed and the difference reading now governs. The objection recorded here was accepted as real and is carried forward as the coverage gap noted under componentMap in CONVENTIONS.md.

ambiguities.issue: Metric (f) is eight numbers carried in a one-scalar MetricValue.
ambiguities.chosen: The female share of the lowest quartile pay band
ambiguities.why: This vector's entire purpose is the single leftover worker, and to_lower puts that worker's effect in Q1. A scalar drawn from any other band would leave the rule this vector exercises invisible in the answer.
ambiguities.supersededBy: resolutions[1] — the passes disagreed and the HIGHEST band now governs. The objection recorded here stands and is the reason the four-band composition is written out in working.

ambiguities.issue: No convention key governs rounding; 400/2800 does not terminate.
ambiguities.why: Four places leave 21.25 and 38 exact while still fixing 14.2857. The convention document has no rounding heading at all, which is the underlying defect.
